articles.title: paperclipai/paperclip
articles.excerpt: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
articles.summary: 用于在工作中管理 AI Agent 的开源应用。它把多个 agent 的创建、调度与运行状态集中到一个界面，方便团队把 agent 纳入日常业务流程，而不是散落在各自的脚本和提示词里。适合正在落地 agent 工作流的开发者与小团队。

articles.title: vectorize-io/hindsight
articles.excerpt: Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns
articles.summary: 为 AI Agent 设计的可学习记忆层，让 agent 在使用过程中积累并更新长期记忆，而不只依赖固定上下文窗口。通过向量检索与记忆演化机制，减少重复提问、提升跨会话一致性，适合需要长期上下文的助手、客服与编码 agent 场景。

articles.title: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer
articles.excerpt: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
articles.summary: NVIDIA 推出的统一模型优化库，汇集量化、蒸馏、剪枝、神经架构搜索、投机解码等 SOTA 技术，用于压缩深度学习模型，降低显存占用与推理延迟。开发者可在训练后组合多种方法优化模型，适合大模型部署与边缘推理场景。

articles.title: dream-num/univer
articles.excerpt: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
articles.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的办公套件运行时，把电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、关系表格和 PDF 统一在同一套引擎中处理。借助其 API，agent 可以像人一样读写与操作办公文件，适合自动化报表、文档生成与协同编辑类应用。

articles.title: tensorflow/tensorflow
articles.excerpt: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
articles.summary: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架，提供从数据预处理、模型构建、训练到部署的完整工具链，支持 CPU、GPU、TPU 以及移动端和浏览器端推理。凭借成熟生态与生产级 Serving 方案，被广泛用于工业界深度学习项目。

articles.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
articles.excerpt: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
articles.summary: 从零开始学习 AI 工程的实践教程，按“先学、再动手构建、最后交付给他人使用”的路径组织内容，覆盖模型调用、检索、Agent 等工程环节。适合想从理论转向可上线 AI 应用的开发者，作为动手练习与项目参考。

articles.title: openbao/openbao
articles.excerpt: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
articles.summary: 开源敏感数据管理方案，用于集中存储、管理和分发密钥、证书与各类机密信息，提供动态密钥、加密即服务、审计日志和细粒度访问控制等能力。作为 HashiCorp Vault 的开源分支，适合需要自建密钥管理基础设施的团队。

articles.title: block/buzz
articles.excerpt: A hive mind communication platform
articles.summary: 由 Block 开源的“蜂群思维”通信平台，面向多主体之间的信息共享与协同，为集体决策类系统提供通信层。适合研究多 agent 协作架构、需要搭建群体通信与消息分发机制的开发者参考和二次开发。

articles.title: microsoft/vscode
articles.excerpt: Visual Studio Code
articles.summary: 微软开源的跨平台代码编辑器，基于 Electron 与 TypeScript 构建，内置 Git、调试、终端与庞大的扩展市场，并通过 Language Server Protocol 支持几乎所有主流语言。它是全球使用最广的开发者编辑器，也常作为云端 IDE 的基础。

articles.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
articles.excerpt: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Cla
articles.summary: 面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包，用 AI 按需分发任务、自动引导工具链安装，并维护可自我演进的知识库。支持 Claude Code 等客户端，适合安全从业者在漏洞分析与取证场景快速调用工具。

articles.title: llvm/llvm-project
articles.excerpt: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
articles.summary: 模块化、可复用的编译器与工具链技术集合，核心包括 LLVM 中间表示、Clang 前端、优化器与代码生成后端，被广泛用作编译器、静态分析、JIT 和 GPU 编程的基础设施。语言实现者与工具链开发者常用它构建新语言和优化后端。

articles.title: anthropics/claude-code-action
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方提供的 GitHub Action，把 Claude Code 接入 CI/CD 流程，可在 issue、PR 评论或工作流事件中触发，让 Claude 自动阅读代码、修改并提交结果。适合希望在仓库里实现自动化代码审查、缺陷修复与任务分派的团队。

articles.title: actions/runner-images

articles.summary: GitHub Actions 官方托管的 runner 镜像仓库，包含 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS 各版本虚拟机上预装软件与工具的清单及构建脚本。开发者可据此确认 CI 环境中可用的依赖，也可参考脚本自建同类 runner 镜像。

articles.title: mobile-next/mobile-mcp
articles.excerpt: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
articles.summary: 基于 Model Context Protocol 的移动端自动化服务器，让 LLM 客户端直接操作 iOS、Android 的真机、模拟器与仿真器，完成界面点击、输入与数据抓取。适合用 agent 做移动 App 测试、RPA 与爬取的开发者。

articles.title: vercel/next.js

articles.summary: Vercel 维护的 React 全栈框架，提供服务端渲染、静态生成、增量再生成、App Router、Server Actions 以及内置的图片与字体优化，并可直接部署到边缘网络，是构建生产级 React 网站与全栈应用的主流选择。

articles.title: How Cloudflare addressed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers
articles.excerpt: External security researchers at Accomplish identified a vulnerability in Cloudflare Containers that could expose residual disk data from previous workloads. We explain how the issue worked, how we investigated it, and the steps we took to remediate it.

articles.title: We just shipped support for the ugliest part of HTTP: Vary
articles.excerpt: Vary support is now available in Cache Rules on every plan. You can normalize known negotiation headers, pass exact values through to the origin when those small differences matter, or bypass cache when the variation is too unpredictable.

articles.title: Introducing Worker Previews: Isolated preview environments for every change your agent makes
articles.excerpt: Worker Previews gives every branch its own URL, configuration, state, and observability, so you and your agents can test changes in parallel without affecting production.

articles.title: Python Workers are now generally available
articles.excerpt: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. You can seamlessly integrate with Cloudflare's ecosystem including D1, R2, and Workers AI without writing any JavaScript glue code.

articles.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's global network is immense but not limitless. As we look for small ways to trim our resource usage, we sometimes get lucky and we can cut significantly more. Here’s how we reduced one of our Pingora-based service's RAM usage with statistics.

articles.title: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts
articles.excerpt: A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation.

articles.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.

articles.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers
articles.excerpt: You can now scope access to individual Workers and assign narrower Developer Platform roles, so teammates, CI tokens, and agents get only the access they need to debug, deploy, or monitor safely.

articles.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.

articles.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it
articles.excerpt: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale.

articles.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
articles.excerpt: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

articles.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)
articles.excerpt: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.

articles.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
articles.excerpt: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. By combining WAF data with OpenAI Daybreak models, Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation helps teams identify and patch the most critical threats first.

articles.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
articles.excerpt: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out.

articles.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
articles.excerpt: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. Cloudflare's new Adaptive Intelligence engine flips this dynamic by autonomously learning from the meta-signals of live traffic and deploying disposable rules

articles.title: BotBase for Operators: A clearer path to joining Cloudflare's directory of bots and agents
articles.excerpt: Bot operators now have a home in the Cloudflare dashboard to manage submissions. This update adds submission status tracking, submission editing, and a behavior model so operators can accurately declare how their bots use content.

articles.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
articles.excerpt: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet.

articles.title: The Cloudflare Blog — brought to you by EmDash
articles.excerpt: We migrated the Cloudflare Blog to EmDash to prove our stack at massive scale. Here is how we stress-tested performance, safely routed production traffic, and redesigned the frontend experience.

articles.title: Say it once: introducing Bot Preference Sync
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's new Bot Preference Sync automatically aligns your robots.txt file with your AI bot policies for Search, Agent, and Training. Easily manage which bots access your content without maintaining static files.
